name: Nadeshiko Ranbu
source:
Focuses on the Yamato Nadeshiko archetype – the ideal Japanese woman, Takahiro resides in Misaki-shi where there is a competition to determine who most depicts the Yamato Nadeshiko. In the past, there was a woman who protected the country during the period of war. The one who excelled in fighting was called the Nadeshiko Ranbu, while the one who excelled in the arts was called the Nadeshiko Ranka. He has to decide which out of the six girls he will support in the competition.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
作品以“大和抚子”这一理想日本女性形象为主题。Takahiro居住的美崎市正在举办一场比赛，选出最能体现大和抚子风范的人。过去，曾有一名女性在战争时期守护国家。其中武艺出众者被称为“抚子乱舞”，才艺出众者则被称为“抚子乱华”。他必须从六名女孩中选出自己要在比赛中支持的人。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
